summary: Master Legal Project Management with the IILPM four-phase framework. Learn to define scope, plan resources, control costs, and report value. Enroll now for 5-da
lede: Legal project management helps legal professionals define matter scope, plan resources, and control time and costs. For professionals leading legal matters, the course covers developing work breakdown structures and timelines, monitoring budgets with earned value management, and managing risks through risk registers and stakeholder communication.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who lead legal matters, manage complex projects, and drive operational excellence in law firms and legal departments. It is ideal for intermediate-level practitioners with 2-5 years of legal experience who need to master the IILPM four-phase framework and deploy digital tools for matter management. By the end of this training, you will be equipped to define scope, plan resources, control costs, and report value with data-driven confidence, transforming legal delivery from reactive to proactive.
modules: Defining Matter Scope and Success Criteria
Integrating LPM with Pricing and Process Improvement
Advanced LPM for Complex Legal Matters
Digital Tools and AI in Legal Project Management
prerequisites: Participants should have basic familiarity with legal matter workflows and project terminology. Experience working on legal projects in any capacity is beneficial but not required. No specific software experience is necessary as hands-on training with Microsoft Project and LeanLegal will be provided. A laptop is recommended for exercises, but the course can be completed without one if you join the virtual lab sessions.
